test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 06 March 2023)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘MADRAS’ is written as ‘112’ and ‘JAMMU’ is written as ‘82’. How will ‘PUNJAB’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- Sum of the position value of the opposite letters according to English alphabetic series is added to the number of letters within the word.

​So,

 
• ‘MADRAS’ is written as ‘112’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7f9d9cb460778cf09eb25b2291182270204400a3031b86054d1f134523d8bbe.png] 

And,

 
• ‘JAMMU’ is written as ‘82’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56e1d4949dcd54813c211bcdffeaacf43e8fe8a471fead205b0ba081b637a4c0.png] 

Similarly,

 
• ‘PUNJAB’ is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/597780a20192cc7dcab184e2181b39a6550fc8077be148de88d1ce748aafcb15.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "104".
